name: problem_020_nvfp4_linear_layer_cuda_cpp
author: jake
description: NVFP4 dense block-scaled GEMM on sm_120 via CUTLASS 4.4.1 OpClassBlockScaledTensorOp. Reuses the reference-mirroring BlockWiseScalerNVFP4 quant prepass + FP4 pack; remaps the plain [D, K/16] FP8 scale tensor into the CUTLASS Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig interleaved SFA/SFB layout; dispatches the CUTLASS GeForce sm_120 NVFP4-BF16 GEMM (example 79a) with x_global_decode*w_global_decode as the linear-combination alpha. FP32 accumulator, BF16 cast at output.
